Core flows (products CRUD, deliveries, sales, collections, sales-returns, routes incl. optimize, customer-types/price lists, upgrade-requests, dev licenses/plans/orgs, stats/overview+leaderboard, payment-vouchers, warehouse-returns, trail, stale debtors) are all exercised by the 198-test suite that passed. No regressions versus iteration_7. No code changes made.

critical_code_review_comments: pytest.ini intentionally parallelizes with xdist (-n 2 --dist loadscope). The shipped suite assumes module-level shared dict state (e.g. S['cid']) that WORKS under loadscope only because each class/module is pinned to one worker — but any new test added at the top level across modules could race. Consider migrating shared state to pytest fixtures to make the suite xdist-safe regardless of distribution strategy.

/api/auth/me returns 200 with role=null for test_token_new. Any client-side route guard must therefore check role, not just 200. The suite confirms protected endpoints (e.g. /api/products) correctly 403 when role is missing.

GET /api/dev/plans returns 405 (no GET collection route). If the frontend lists plans anywhere, confirm it uses the correct endpoint (likely /api/dev/plans is POST-only for create; listing may be via /api/dev/orgs or a dedicated endpoint). Not a bug, just worth noting for FE wiring.
